# Director of Engineering, Frontend technologies, Marketplace Technologies

Engineering
Berlin, Germany
Loopmarket Marketplace

## Brief info about Loopmarket
Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Loopmarket Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

[Loopmarket Marketplace](#) is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

[Loopmarket Go](#) enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 450,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 50 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

[Loopmarket Pay](#) is the newest part of the Loopmarket Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Loopmarket app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2010 in Examplia, Loopmarket began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2020, we became Examplia's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Lakeside, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 1,800 people. 

## About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold: 

1. __Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency:__ we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.
2. __Drive strategic engineering initiatives:__ architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web.

You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.

You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.

## In this position, you will

__Strategically:__

- __Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace.__ We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job 
- __Drive Technology Strategy:_ Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. 
- __Refine the domain's identity:__ Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.

__Tactically:__

- __Lead frontends:__ Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.
- __Lead Initiatives:__ Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.
- __Elevate global UI quality:__ Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.
- __Ensure Resilience & Reliability:__ Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.
- __Innovate & Optimize:__ Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.

__A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority:__ Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.

## About you

__How much of a technical acumen?__ Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.

__Leadership:__ you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority. 

__Change horizon:__ You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.

__What this role is not:__ This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.

## Working at Loopmarket

### Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

### Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.
